hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';const destructive=/atlassian-cli\s+(confluence|conf)\s+(page\s+(create|update|upsert|append|delete|move)|page\s+label-(add|remove)|page\s+property-(set|delete)|attachment\s+(upload|delete)|template\s+(create|delete))/.test(cmd);if(destructive){console.error('[Confluence Constitution] BLOCKED: This command modifies Confluence data.');console.error('[Confluence Constitution] Command: '+cmd.substring(0,200));console.error('[Confluence Constitution] You MUST use AskUserQuestion to get explicit user approval before executing this command.');console.error('[Confluence Constitution] Show: exact command, what it does, target page/space, risk level, reversibility.');process.exit(2)}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.description: Confluence Constitution: Block write operations (page create/update/delete, attachments, labels, properties, templates) until user confirms
